title: First completion of the field loader
statement: For every Boolean input word $x$, input-head position $p$ among its $|x|+2$ positions, stream prefix $\mathrm{pre}$, field $w$, stream tail, and old target word, there is a time $t$ with $0<t\le 2|\mathrm{old}|+3|w|+6$ such that, at every earlier time $j<t$, the machine is not in its completed control. At time $t$ it is in the completed reading control, with target contents exactly $w$ and target head at zero, stream head at $|\mathrm{pre}|+2|w|+2$, the original input position, stream contents, and input unchanged, and empty physical output.
hypotheses_covered: Existence of a positive time bounded by $2|\mathrm{old}|+3|w|+6$
No earlier time $j<t$ is in the completed control
At time $t$, exact equality with the specified completed reader configuration
replaced: For every input word, input position, stream prefix, field word $w$, stream tail, and old target, there is a strictly positive time, at most twice the old target length plus $3|w| + 6$, at which the unrestricted loader first reaches its completed control, holding exactly $w$ with restored target head and advanced stream cursor; no bound relating the old and new lengths is assumed.
